features.name: Projects and character workshop
features.detail: Create, edit and organize your own projects, characters, scenes and objects.

features.name: Local AI agent
features.detail: Install with -WithLocalAI and configure a model. Defaults off with approval required.

features.name: Image and video generation
features.detail: Sanitized Krea/reference/H3 presets included. Model weights are separate. Validate each recipe in ComfyUI.

features.name: 3D set workshop
features.detail: Portable Blender can be installed with -WithBlender.

features.name: Voice, lip-sync, transcription and training
features.detail: Adapters exist but their specialized dependencies and models are not provisioned by core setup.

features.name: Visual LoRA library
features.detail: Pinned LoRA Manager, workspace-local metadata and sidecars, shared SFW weights. Fresh installs use Harness/install_lora_manager.py.

features.name: Shot LoRAs and keyframes
features.detail: Ordered model-only LoRA stacks, explicit family checks, strengths, first and last frame references; native canvas and API graphs remain synchronized.

features.name: Anima and 360 orbit recipes
features.status: Locally rendered; models required on fresh installs
features.detail: Anima Turbo 512-square test and H3 768-square / 73-frame silent orbit completed. Orbit replaces turbo with its own 28-step recipe; new subjects require visual review.

features.name: Timeline source monitor
features.detail: Assembly scrubber and clip navigation alongside trimming and ordering. Render local preview applies transitions, grading and layered audio; these are not simulated live.
